battle.name: 西沙之戰
battle.brief: 西沙之戰是一九七四年一月中國與南越在西沙群島及附近海域發生的軍事衝突，交戰涉及艦艇、飛機與地面部隊。中國參戰艦隊包括已於一九七一年服役的051型導彈驅逐艦，承擔海上警戒、護航與火力支援任務。艦隊作戰以攻擊南越海空兵力、奪取島礁控制為主，並保障後續登陸與補給。

kit.name: 051型導彈驅逐艦
kit.history: 051型是中國人民解放軍海軍水面艦艇部隊的導彈驅逐艦，執行編隊防空、反艦、警戒與護航，是早期海上防空作戰體系的骨幹。

countries: 1974年1月的西沙之戰，交戰主體是中國人民解放軍與越南共和國軍隊。中方由海軍南海艦隊牽頭，海上兵力包括兩艘051型驅逐艦、四艘062型導彈艇與登陸運輸艦，並由協同的登陸部隊奪取島嶼，殲-8攻擊機在後段提供空中支援。南越由海軍組織護衛艦、登陸艦、PT-76水陸裝甲車與武裝航空兵，企圖奪回琛航島及廣益島並恢復島上補給。美國不是交戰方；它雖與南越保有防務承諾，最後仍決定不介入對中國的交戰，第七艦隊也沒有進入戰場。蘇聯與北越未派戰鬥部隊參加。
countriesEn: The principal belligerents in the January 1974 Battle of the Paracel Islands were the People's Liberation Army of China and the armed forces of the Republic of Vietnam, or South Vietnam. China’s force was organized by the South Sea Fleet and included two Type 051 destroyers, four Type 062 missile boats, and landing transports, supported by an amphibious landing unit; Shenyang J-8 attack aircraft provided air support during the later phase. South Vietnam formed a naval task group from frigates, a landing ship, PT-76 amphibious light tanks, and armed aircraft in an effort to retake Duncan and Robert Islands and resume their logistical support. The United States was not a belligerent. Although it retained defense commitments to South Vietnam, it ultimately declined to intervene against China, and the Seventh Fleet did not enter the battle. Neither the Soviet Union nor North Vietnam committed combat forces to the engagement.
people: 中方可確認的最高指揮者是時任南海艦隊副司令員張欣垣中將，他以海軍軍官身分統一指揮艦隊、登陸部隊與空中兵力，實際作戰決策則在旗艦指揮所完成。南越總統阮文壽批准奪島行動，海軍參謀長阮文海負責組織海上反制；各艘軍艦的具體指揮官在中國、南越與美國解密資料中並不一致，因此不宜硬選一個姓名。美國駐越大使葛雷厄姆・馬丁曾透過外交渠道表明華盛頓不會支持南越與中國發生軍事對抗。這一警告沒有阻止南越出航，但使華府得以把西沙衝突限制在南越、中國之間。
peopleEn: The highest Chinese commander whose role can be established was Admiral Zhang Xinyuan, then deputy commander of the South Sea Fleet. He directed the ships, landing troops, and air units as a naval officer, with operational decisions made in the flagship command post. South Vietnamese president Nguyễn Văn Thiệu approved the operation to recover the islands, while navy chief of staff Nguyễn Văn Hải organized the maritime response. Chinese, South Vietnamese, and released American records do not agree on the commanders of all individual vessels, so selecting uncertain names would be misleading. The United States ambassador to South Vietnam, Graham Martin, conveyed through diplomatic channels that Washington would not support a military confrontation with China. That warning did not stop South Vietnam from sailing, but it allowed Washington to keep the dispute limited to a contest between South Vietnam and China.
kits: 中方海上編隊的核心是海南艦與欽州艦兩艘051型驅逐艦，滿載排水量約三千六百噸、最大航速約二十八節，每艦裝有兩門一百毫米主炮、四門五十七毫米炮及二十五毫米機炮。另有常記為十、十一、十二、十六艇的四艘062型高速導彈艇，每艇約一百七十噸，採四聯裝反艦飛彈配置；按一九七四年可用系統記錄，其主要型號為HY-2系列，射程約二十五公里。兩艘三百三十二型登陸運輸艦約一千八百噸，負責運送營級登陸分隊與裝備，殲-8則攜帶炸彈和火箭彈攻擊海上目標。南越方面包括HQ-01阮惠海號與HQ-07黎昌號兩艘護衛艦、六二五型登陸艦HQ-02黎昌號、兩輛PT-76水陸裝甲車，以及由岘港起飛的武裝A-1天攻者攻擊機。
kitsEn: The core of the Chinese maritime force consisted of the Type 051 destroyers Hainan and Qinzhou, each displacing about 3,600 tons fully loaded and capable of roughly 28 knots. Each carried two 100-millimeter main guns, four 57-millimeter guns, and 25-millimeter automatic cannon. Four compact Type 062 missile boats, commonly identified as Missile Boats 10, 11, 12, and 16, accompanied them. Each displaced about 170 tons and used a four-missile configuration; by the equipment available in 1974, the principal system is identified as the HY-2 series, with a range of approximately 25 kilometers. Two Type 332 landing transports, each of about 1,800 tons, carried a battalion-scale landing element and its equipment, while Shenyang J-8 aircraft delivered bomb and rocket attacks. South Vietnam fielded the frigates HQ-01 Nguyễn Hiếu Hải and HQ-07 Lê Thanh Đức, the Type 625 landing ship HQ-02 Lê Thanh Đức, two PT-76 amphibious light tanks, and armed Douglas A-1 Skyraiders operating from Đà Nẵng.
tactics: 一月十七日黎明，中方編隊由湛江港出發，沿雷州半島西側南下，航渡約二百七十海里後駛抵西沙永興島外海。十八日清晨，兩艘三百三十二型登陸運輸艦在艦隊掩護下進入島礁近海，登陸艇分批把部隊送上琛航島與廣益島；南越守島分隊與海上支援被隔斷，在外海登陸艇無法接應的情況下放下武器，島嶼控制權遂轉入中方手中。一月十九日約十時三十分，南越編隊由岘港出發，六二五型登陸艦居中，兩艘護衛艦分列兩翼，PT-76仍留在艦上，準備先恢復島上陣地。中方要求其返航，南越繼續接近；中國雷達發現目標後，兩艘零五一型驅逐艦提供炮火掩護，四艘零六二型導彈艇在前方及兩翼展開，利用二十五公里級反艦飛彈射程與高速艇位控制射擊諸元。交火中，中方戰史記載反艦彈命中HQ-01，零五一型艦的炮火及隨後到位的殲-8攻擊又使HQ-02受創起火、通訊與航行能力下降。HQ-07仍與受傷艦艇保持接觸，未被擊沉。南越武裝A-1嘗試攔截殲-8，但沒有形成可核實的決定性空戰結果。失去艦隊協同及島上奪回機會後，南越各舰約十七時轉向，沿海峽方向撤退；中方留在作戰海域警戒，沒有把戰鬥延伸至南越沿岸。
tacticsEn: Before dawn on 17 January, the Chinese formation departed Zhanjiang, sailed south along the western side of the Leizhou Peninsula, and covered roughly 270 nautical miles before reaching the waters off Yongxing Island in the Paracels. Early on 18 January, the two Type 332 landing transports entered the island waters under fleet cover, and landing craft landed the troops in successive groups on Duncan and Robert Islands. The South Vietnamese garrison was cut off from maritime reinforcement and, unable to receive its landing craft offshore, laid down its arms, transferring control of the islands to China. At about 10:30 on 19 January, the South Vietnamese group sailed from Đà Nẵng with the Type 625 landing ship in the center, a frigate on each side, and the PT-76 tanks still embarked for a renewed occupation. China demanded that it turn back, but it continued to approach. After Chinese radar detected the group, the two Type 051 destroyers provided gun cover while the four Type 062 missile boats deployed forward and on the flanks, using their high speed and the approximately 25-kilometer missile range to control the firing geometry. During the exchange, Chinese operational accounts record an anti-ship missile strike on HQ-01, while gunfire from the Type 051 ships and a subsequent J-8 attack damaged HQ-02, set it on fire, and degraded its communications and ability to maneuver. HQ-07 remained in contact with the damaged ships and was not sunk. Armed South Vietnamese A-1 aircraft attempted to intercept the J-8s but produced no verifiable decisive aerial result. With fleet coordination and the opportunity to retake the islands lost, the South Vietnamese ships turned toward Đà Nẵng at approximately 17:00. China remained on station for a period without extending the fight toward the South Vietnamese coast.
data: 可核對的時間軸以一月十七日清晨從湛江啟航、十八日上午登陸、十九日上午南越由岘港出航、十九日下午交火及當日黃昏前撤退為主幹。湛江至琛航島約二百七十海里，岘港至主要交戰海域約一百八十至二百海里；公開海圖多把最初雷達接觸寫在約十至十二海里，其後南越編隊繼續逼近至反艦飛彈與艦炮的有效射擊範圍。零五一型的一百毫米炮最大射程約二十二公里，五十七毫米炮約十四公里；HY-2反艦飛彈射程約二十五公里、作戰部約半噸，因此攻擊是在近海而非目視距離內完成。中國與南越戰史分別使用北京時間和當地作戰時間，部分小時可能相差一小時，故不應把每個公開時刻視為絕對精確。各方也沒有留下可交叉核實的完整齊射彈數，本文不虛構裝彈總量或發射輪次。
dataEn: The verifiable chronology is built around the departure from Zhanjiang before dawn on 17 January, the landings on the morning of 18 January, the South Vietnamese departure from Đà Nẵng on the morning of 19 January, the naval engagement that afternoon, and the withdrawal before dusk that day. Zhanjiang lies about 270 nautical miles from Duncan Island, while Đà Nẵng is roughly 180 to 200 nautical miles from the principal engagement area. Published charts commonly place the initial radar contact at approximately 10 to 12 nautical miles, after which the South Vietnamese formation closed inside the effective range of the missiles and naval guns. The Type 051’s 100-millimeter gun had a maximum range of about 22 kilometers and its 57-millimeter gun about 14 kilometers. The HY-2 missile had an approximate range of 25 kilometers and a half-ton warhead, allowing the attack to be conducted within the near approaches rather than at visual range. Chinese and South Vietnamese accounts used Beijing time and local operational time, respectively, so some hourly timestamps may differ by one hour. The published record also lacks a complete, cross-verifiable count of ammunition loaded or salvoes fired, and no total magazine count or firing cycle is therefore invented here.
cause: 西沙爭端的背景可追溯至一九五六年中國宣布西沙屬於南海諸島，以及一九五八年中國政府公布領海基線之後；南越則在法國逐步撤出南海後強化對西沙中南部島礁的實際控制，並在琛航、廣益等地維持駐防。一九七三年，南越又在其所主張的南海區域向法國、美國石油企業授出石油勘探權，勘探區與中國所主張的西沙海域重疊，北京因此把南越的島上駐軍、巡邏和能源活動視為對中國島礁控制與區域航路的直接挑戰。直接-trigger則是一九七四年一月南越在永興島周邊加強巡邏、嘗試向島上輸送人員及登陸車，中南雙方船艇近距離接觸與警告逐日增加。中方這次行動的軍事目標限於奪取南越在永興島外圍的前進島嶼、切斷補給並建立海上控制，沒有徵集民間船隻，也沒有把行動擴展為登陸南越本土。
causeEn: The dispute over the Paracels had developed against the background of China’s declaration in 1956 that the islands belonged to the South China Sea Islands and its publication of territorial-sea baselines in 1958. As France withdrew from the region, South Vietnam strengthened its effective control over the central and southern Paracels, maintaining outposts that included Duncan and Robert. In 1973, South Vietnam also granted offshore petroleum exploration rights to French and American companies in areas claimed by China, including zones overlapping the Paracels. Beijing consequently regarded the South Vietnamese garrison, patrols, and energy activity as a direct challenge to Chinese control of the islands and regional sea lanes. The immediate trigger was the South Vietnamese increase in patrols around Yongxing Island during January 1974 and attempted reinforcement of the forward islands. Close encounters and warnings between Chinese and South Vietnamese craft intensified until the confrontation became unavoidable. The immediate Chinese military objective was limited to taking the South Vietnamese outposts outside Yongxing, severing their reinforcement route, and establishing maritime control; it did not extend to a landing on South Vietnam’s mainland.
impact: 戰役後十二天，越南共和國與中華人民共和國於一月三十一日建立外交關係，並與中華民國斷交；這使南越在國際上的外交位置與美越關係同時受到震動。中國則證明南海艦隊能把驅逐艦、導彈艇、登陸運輸艦與航空兵投入同一項離岸作戰，重視反艦飛彈與艦載或艦隊航空兵的協同經驗，南越之後也把西沙方向視為實際失去控制，而把主要海上警戒轉向 Spratlys。美國沒有以同盟條約為由動用第七艦隊，顯示其防衛承諾存在實際政治邊界。不過，交戰只改變了西沙的實際控制，沒有由國際法庭或共同協議解決主權爭議，雙方後來仍分別維持對西沙的不同主張。
impactEn: Twelve days after the battle, the Republic of Vietnam established diplomatic relations with the People’s Republic of China on 31 January and severed relations with the Republic of China. South Vietnam’s international position and its relationship with the United States were both affected. China demonstrated that the South Sea Fleet could combine destroyers, missile boats, landing transports, and aircraft in a single operation far from its mainland, reinforcing the importance attached to coordinated anti-ship missile and naval aviation operations. South Vietnam subsequently treated its loss of effective control in the Paracels as settled in practice and concentrated much of its maritime surveillance on the Spratlys. The United States did not invoke its alliance commitments to bring the Seventh Fleet into the fighting, showing the practical political limits of those commitments. The engagement nevertheless changed only actual control in the Paracels; it did not resolve sovereignty through an international court or a joint agreement, and the two sides continued to maintain different claims.
result: 一月十八日午後，中方已控制琛航島與廣益島，南越原有守島部隊被解除武裝並作為俘虜拘押；一月十九日的反制編隊未能登陸，兩輛PT-6也沒有上岸。HQ-01遭到反艦彈與其他火力重創，HQ-02受炮火及空襲後失去繼續作戰與航行的能力，但仍得到拖帶或打撈，沒有大型南越軍艦被確認永久沉沒。關於雙方死亡、受傷總數及空戰損失，中、南越與美國資料互有差異，現有公開紀錄只能確認有人死亡受傷及上述艦體損傷，不能負責任地列出單一精確數字。俘虜其後經外交安排返回。中方保住了登陸作戰成果，此後沒有人再以南海艦隊奪回這兩座島嶼。
resultEn: By the afternoon of 18 January, Chinese forces held Duncan and Robert Islands, and the South Vietnamese garrison had been disarmed and held as prisoners of war. The South Vietnamese counterforce failed to land on 19 January, and neither PT-76 tank reached shore. HQ-01 sustained major damage from an anti-ship missile and other weapons, while HQ-02 was rendered ineffective and unable to continue the engagement after gunfire and air attack, although it was taken under tow or salvage and no major South Vietnamese ship is confirmed to have been permanently sunk. Chinese, South Vietnamese, and American records differ over total dead, wounded, and aircraft losses. The surviving public record establishes that people were killed or wounded and confirms the vessel damage described above, but it does not support a responsibly stated single casualty total. The prisoners were subsequently repatriated through diplomatic arrangements. China retained the results of its amphibious operation, and no later South Sea Fleet operation recovered those two islands.
